title: Segment Anything
layout_note: Three panels in a row, each captioned beneath with a letter and a bold keyword: (a) Task, (b) Model, (c) Data. Panel (a) shows the task as inputs-model-output, (b) opens the model box, (c) shows a data-engine loop above a dataset card.
grouping: Panels are separated by whitespace only. In (a) four small square prompt panels (points, box, mask, text) sit in a row gathered by a curly brace into one arrow to a pale-yellow 'model' box, with the image thumbnail entering from the right. In (b) a large pale-yellow container (the same yellow as the model box in (a) and (c)) holds three coloured sub-blocks. In (c) a loop of thin arrows labelled 'annotate' and 'train' joins the yellow model box and a blue rounded 'data' pill; a dashed grey arrow drops from the pill to a large rounded blue card describing the dataset.
shapes_depth: Flat pale fills with thin same-hue outlines, no shadows, serif labels in grey. Prompts are drawn literally inside small black-outlined squares: red and green dots for foreground/background points, a black rectangle for a box, a pale blue blob for a mask, and the words 'cat with black ears' for text. Input and output are photo thumbnails, the output with a translucent blue mask over one object. In (b) the image encoder is a tall green box, the prompt encoder a small purple box and the lightweight mask decoder a wide orange bar across the top. The dataset card holds a bullet list with the first bullet in bold and a photo with many coloured mask overlays.
proposed_highlight: The model keeps one identity colour (pale yellow) wherever it appears across the three panels, and the panel captions bold the keyword and the acronyms (SAM, SA-1B). The four prompt types are depicted as drawings of the prompts themselves rather than named.
lesson: Show a promptable model's interface by drawing every prompt type literally in small identical squares (dots for points, a rectangle for a box, a blob for a mask, the words for text) bracketed into a single input arrow beside the image.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year (2304.02643); venue ICCV as recorded from Semantic Scholar, the venue's year not verified. 'other' in elements stands for the annotate/train loop arrows of panel (c).

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: a segmentation prompt and an image converge on one model that outputs a valid mask - in (a) four prompt glyphs gathered by a brace plus a photo, in (b) a small prompt encoder and a large image encoder feeding one lightweight mask decoder

relations.form: (a) a brace collects the prompt squares and an arrow from the image photo meets them at a wide yellow 'model' box, with the masked photo above; (b) prompt and image arrows rise from below into their encoders and then into the decoder bar
(a) four equal white squares side by side show the prompt types: points (coloured dots), a box, a mask blob, and text 'cat with black ears'
(b) is a large pale-yellow panel with the same tint as (a)'s 'model' box, opening it into the prompt encoder, image encoder and mask decoder
(c) top: a rectangular loop model -> annotate -> data -> train -> model drawn with right-angle arrows
(c) bottom: a grey dashed line from the 'data' pill leads to a blue rounded card listing SA-1B facts with a sample masked photo

channels.colour: yellow = the model in every panel (a, b, c); green = image encoder, purple = prompt encoder, orange = decoder; blue = data (data pill, SA-1B card) and also the blue mask-prompt blob in (a)
channels.shape: rectangles = models, pill = data, white squares = prompts, photos = images and masks
channels.line: solid grey arrows = flow; one grey dashed line = 'detail of' from data to the dataset card
channels.frame: panels separated by whitespace and captions; the yellow panel in (b) frames the model

quality.strengths: each panel has one job (task, model, data) and the yellow model tint ties all three; box size encodes cost in (b) - a large image encoder beside a small prompt encoder under a thin 'lightweight' decoder; prompts are drawn as glyphs of their kind
quality.weaknesses: panel (b) draws no data between encoders and decoder (no embedding); the data-engine loop in (c) is four words around two boxes with long right-angle arrows; blue means both 'data' and a mask prompt

insights.structure: Three panels in a row separated by whitespace and captioned beneath '(a) Task', '(b) Model', '(c) Data': (a) inputs-model-output, (b) an opened pale-yellow model container with three coloured sub-blocks, (c) a model/data annotate-train loop above a large blue dataset card.
insights.data: The four prompt types are drawn literally in identical black-outlined squares (red/green dots, a rectangle, a blue blob, the words 'cat with black ears'), and input/output are photo thumbnails with a translucent blue mask on the output.
insights.emphasis: The model keeps one pale-yellow identity colour in all three panels, and captions bold the keyword and the acronyms SAM and SA-1B.
insights.flow: Panels (a) and (b) read bottom-to-top from prompt/image to 'valid mask'; panel (c) is a clockwise loop of thin arrows labelled annotate and train with a dashed grey arrow down to the dataset card.
insights.avoid: Panel (c)'s dataset card uses a tiny photo and four grey bullets that read as text clutter beside the diagram panels.

arrangement.units: three unframed panels separated by whitespace, each captioned below with a letter and bold keyword; they are facets (task, model, data) rather than sequential stages
arrangement.inputs_as: a row of four drawn prompt squares gathered by a curly brace, plus a photo thumbnail labelled 'image'
arrangement.shared: the pale-yellow model box appears in all three panels
